title: Bespoke Enterprise 3D Tech Pavilion
shortDescription: A turnkey 180 sqm enterprise pavilion featuring seamless curved wood architecture, acrylic backlit logos, and experiential customer demo zones.
description: Engineered and fabricated from ground up for Global Tech Expo at Pragati Maidan. The brief required a towering presence with 360-degree brand visibility, dedicated private lounge for B2B buyer meetings, and 4 interactive product demonstration pods.
features: Seamless High-Gloss Duco Finish Wooden Walls
P3 Ultra-HD Curved LED Video Screen Integration
materials: 12mm Raised Platform with HPL Laminate Flooring

title: Rapid Modular & Octanorm Hybrid Stall
shortDescription: A sustainable, reconfigurable hybrid stall combining engineered aluminum extrusion profiles with bespoke wooden brand fascias.
description: Constructed for an urgent 24-hour setup window at BIEC Bengaluru. Enabled the client to stand out dramatically from neighboring shell scheme booths at half the carbon footprint and budget of full wooden fabrication.

title: Two-Story Double Decker VIP Pavilion
shortDescription: Heavy-duty certified steel & wood mezzanine stand with executive buyer lounge, panoramic upper terrace, and ground-level machinery display.
description: Built for maximum footprint efficiency at IEML Greater Noida. The double-decker structural framework was precision-calculated with certified load-bearing safety, granting the client double the usable area within the same paid booth perimeter.
features: Upper-Deck VIP Lounge with Coffee Bar
Acoustic Ceiling Panels for Quiet Negotiations
Open Panoramic Balcony Overlooking Expo Hall
materials: ISMC Heavy Structural Mild Steel Columns & Beams
Frosted Privacy Glass Panels & Stainless Handrails

title: Fashion Week Runway & Backdrop Pavilion
shortDescription: High-fashion geometric wooden pavilion with luxury acoustic timber fins, illuminated brass trims, and an elevated VIP runway backdrop.
description: Precision fabricated for Fashion Week at Pragati Maidan. Designed with faceted warm oak paneling, integrated warm LED linear grazing lights, and secluded buyer lounge quarters.
features: Integrated VIP Runway Backdrop with Matte Finish
Custom Fabricated Reception Pods with Brass Accents

title: 4-Side Open Island Footfall Stand
shortDescription: An unobstructed 4-side open island booth engineered with a towering central illuminated fascia, model display plinths, and 8 consultation tables.
description: Designed to capture maximum foot traffic from all 4 primary aisles. The central suspended truss structure featured 360-degree backlit fabric branding that could be seen from anywhere across the expo hall.
features: Unobstructed Footfall Circulation from All 4 Aisles

title: Interactive Product Launch & AV Booth
shortDescription: Dark-aesthetic futuristic booth with seamless LED video walls, interactive touchscreen demo pods, and synchronized RGB accent lighting.
description: Fabricated for a major software and gaming reveal. The layout featured an enclosed theater section for keynote product demos, paired with open-access hands-on testing kiosks.
features: P2.5 High-Contrast Seamless LED Video Wall (6m × 3m)
Synchronized DMX LED Channel Lighting Effects
Integrated Audio System with Directed Speakers
Dark Matte Finish with Neon Lime Accents
materials: Heavy Duty Raised Platform with Anti-Static Coating

title: Corporate Conference & Symposium Lounge
shortDescription: Sleek, minimalist Scandinavian-inspired executive booth featuring warm oak slat accents, open discussion lounges, and private meeting pods.
description: Tailored for high-level business forums where quiet, professional conversations and literature distribution are paramount. Delivered on schedule at Pragati Maidan.
features: Real Wood Fluted Slat Feature Walls

title: Aviation Airshow Stand & Experience Zone
shortDescription: State-of-the-art interactive aerospace exhibit stand featuring flight simulator pods, panoramic LED screens, and aerospace hospitality suite.
description: Engineered for international airshow exhibitions. Combines futuristic high-tensile architectural styling with high-performance audio-visuals for immersive visitor engagement.
features: Flight Simulator & Cockpit Demo Pod Integration
Executive Flight Crew & Buyer Hospitality Lounge

title: Classic Octanorm Modular Shell Scheme Stall
shortDescription: Standard German-engineered 8-sided aluminum extrusion shell scheme stall with branded header fascia, lockable reception desk, and spotlight arms.
description: Precision-assembled for Pragati Maidan Hall 11. Designed using authentic Octanorm 4.3mm groove extrusion uprights and quick-tension locks, delivering a clean, sustainable, and 100% reusable exhibition space within a tight 12-hour build window.
features: Modular Tension Lock Beam Fastening Mechanism
Lockable Octanorm Reception Desk with Brochure Rack
Seamless Vinyl Laminated High-Density PVC Infill Panels

title: Octanorm Maxima 80 Hybrid Corner Pavilion
shortDescription: Architectural Maxima 80 heavy aluminum frame hybrid stall featuring backlit SEG tension fabric lightboxes, glass display vitrines, and wooden oak accents.
description: Constructed for India Expo Mart (IEML) Hall 3. Combines heavy 80mm Octanorm Maxima architectural aluminum beams with custom warm timber feature walls and silicone edge graphic (SEG) backlit lightboxes for a striking corner presence.
features: Heavy-Duty Octanorm Maxima 80mm Square Aluminum Columns
Integrated Frameless Silicone Edge Graphics (SEG) Lightbox
Lockable Tempered Glass Showcase Display Vitrines
Private Discussion Lounge with Acoustic Charcoal Felt Partitions
Raised Wooden Platform Flooring with Perimeter Warm LED Glow
materials: Heavy Gauge Maxima 80 Aluminum Structural Beams
Real Oak Timber Veneer Wall Paneling
